name: namejs
description: Map-based tactical simulation: platoons, units, and combat.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace server && npm run test --workspace client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace shared && tsc --noEmit -p server && tsc -b client
scripts.dev: npm run dev:server & npm run dev:client
